newsitem.title: USA: Uno sees Q3 charge, net loss $0.09 share.
newsitem.headline: Uno sees Q3 charge, net loss $0.09 share.

text.p: Uno Restaurant Corp said Thursday it is expecting to report a third quarter net loss of about $0.09 a share after a $4 million charge for the write-off of two restaurants.

The company said the $4 million pre-tax charge relates principally to a non-cash write-off of assets associated with two Pizzeria Uno restaurants that have accounted for operating losses of about $350,000 in the past year.
The charge amounts to $2,640,000 after-tax, or $0.22 a share.
Excluding the charge, third quarter earnings are expected to be $0.13 per share, compared to $0.12 a share for the 1996 third quarter.
The company said it expects fourth quarter earnings of about $0.17 to $0.19 a share, compared to $0.19 a share in the year-ago fourth quarter.
Consequently, it said, fiscal year 1997 should be $0.45 to $0.47 a share, excluding the charge of $022 per share in the third quarter.
The company said it would issue its final earnings report July 15.
